name: Scatha's Teachers

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: Improves a unit's attack capabilities for an extended period of time.

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

attributes.name: Berserk
attributes.text: This unit can go berserk during the battle. This makes them uncontrollable, they will automatically attack nearby enemies.

attributes.name: Guerrilla Deployment
attributes.text: This unit can deploy outside of the deployment zone.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Scare (everyone)
attributes.text: This unit frightens all enemy units.

attributes.name: Immune to Fear
attributes.text: This unit is immune to the fear effects of scary units.

attributes.name: Stalk
attributes.text: This unit can move hidden in any terrain.

short: These stealthy warriors blend in with their surroundings, just as the shadow maid taught them.
history: A powerful warrior woman and a legendary general, Scatha or Scáthach is a major character in the mythological Ulster Cycle. Known as 'the Shadow' and 'the Warrior Maid', colour plates have been discovered that depict Scatha teaching Cú Chulainn of Ulster the many ways of battle, and even gifting him the "friendship of her thighs" near the end of his training! Naturally, with such an auspicious start, Cú Chulainn goes on to become a legendary figure in his own right. It is notable that the Celtic martial arts were usually taught by women, some believing that the teachers were also priestesses, and that they conferred additional powers to their chosen students when in battle.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
